newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares seen firmer but range-bound.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares seen firmer but range-bound.

text.p: Jakarta shares are expected to be firmer in early trading on Thursday, with heavyweight Bank Negara Indonesia seen leading the market, brokers said.
They said the market would try to sustain its upward trend after the share index climbed to a new high on Wednesday.
"Bank Negara Indonesia is likely to continue leading market activity today," a local broker said.
Brokers said possible gains in Bank Negara Indonesia was likely to push up the index. But they said possible profit taking in heavyweight telecommunications firm Telkom could limit the index's rise.
Telkom closed $3/4 lower at $35 in New York overnight after closing at 4,250 rupiah in Jakarta on Wednesday.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta index closed up 5.24 points, or 0.77 percent, at 686.12 points after peaking at a record high of 687.65.
The previous record of 681.94 points was achieved on April 4, 1990. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
